Salman Khan to move from Galaxy Apartments after 52 years

Actor Salman Khan is reportedly set to leave his long-time residence, Galaxy Apartments, after 52 years. He has reportedly received approval for a new six-storey home. The move marks a significant personal transition for the actor.
